# Emerald Echo

Emerald Echo is a green, terminal-inspired theme with dark and light modes that its recorded description tailors to notes carrying a top-level H1, which it makes stand out. Heading levels are separated by distinct colors and underline styles, and bold, italic, highlighted text and local versus external links are given high-contrast treatments the description says also hold on mobile.

![Emerald Echo screenshot](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/malcolmmielle/Emerald-Echo/HEAD/screenshot.png)

```cue
theme: {
    name:   "Emerald Echo"
    author: "malcolmmielle"
    repo:   "malcolmmielle/Emerald-Echo"
    slug:   "emerald-echo"

    html_url:       "https://community.obsidian.md/themes/emerald-echo"
    github_url:     "https://github.com/malcolmmielle/Emerald-Echo"
    screenshot_url: "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/malcolmmielle/Emerald-Echo/HEAD/screenshot.png"

    modes: ["dark", "light"]
    about: "Apply a green, terminal-inspired dark/light Obsidian theme that makes H1 titles pop and is tailored for notes with a top H1. Distinguish heading levels at a glance with distinct colors and underline styles, and render bold, italics, highlights and local vs external links with clear, high-contrast styling that works on mobile."
}
```
